text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, Grass Wonder officially<n>begins her quest
through the Twinkle<n>Series!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Eager to discuss what lies ahead, I<n>head to her
classroom so I can walk<n>her to the office myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Spe? That kanji character<n>isn't quite right.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-which one?! Where?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
(Looks like she's talking to Special<n>Week—an
Umamusume from<n>Hokkaido who's in the same
year as<n>her.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, hold on. First, let's try and<n>chill for a
second. I can't see the<n>paper with your hands in
the way.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
(And that's Seiun Sky, who is also<n>making her
debut soon. Her manner<n>of communication can be a
tad<n>indirect at times.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You have the wrong radical on the left<n>side of
"whirlpool." The one you've<n>written makes the
kanji for<n>"disaster."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, um, um... So, I need to do it like...<n>this?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What chicken scratch is that, Spe?!<n>I've seen better
handwritin' from a<n>six year old!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Meanie!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Dear me. If even El is correcting your<n>penmanship, I
fear you may have a<n>long way to go...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hey!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
(Another classmate in the same year,<n>El Condor
Pasa is an Umamusume<n>with a big and bright
personality. She<n>also shares a room with Grass
Wonder.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Spe, there's plenty of<n>time. Just take
a few deep breaths<n>and correct the mistake.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'll try!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! I didn't realize you were<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! You're Grass's trainer! Is she<n>late for
training?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I'm so sorry! It's all my faaault!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... You see... I scored so bad on<n>our quiz that I
have to do extra<n>homework!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: She's not allowed to train until it gets<n>done, either.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However, with our debuts coming up,<n>she can't
afford to miss a single<n>session.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Exactamente! So, less tears and more<n>writing, Spe!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Spirit! Guts! Effooort!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: A little effort before the test would'vebeen nice too, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I know, I knooow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, that is the situation,<n>Trainer. Would
you mind waiting a<n>little longer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Now, let's continue, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Haste makes waste. This is the<n>perfect opportunity
to refocus and<n>learn from your mistake.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Think about what a whirlpool is made<n>of. Water,
right? So the correct kanji<n>should have the "water"
radical.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-oh! That makes sense! I can<n>remember that!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder skillfully gives concise<n>but useful
advice to help Special<n>Week finish her extra
homework.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting, Trainer.
choice_data_list: You all seem like good friends.
You all seem like good friends.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I really value our friendship.<n>Each of them is
quite different, which<n>makes our time together
enjoyable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Though of course, that isn't all...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As members of the same generation,<n>we are bound
to face one another<n>many times on the track as
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Her expression remains calm as she<n>says this.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But something about her aura makes<n>my skin
prickle ever so slightly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, you wanted to discuss our plans<n>from here
on, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I know we need to talk about things<n>like training
and our race agenda.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But I have something to give you first.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, Grass Wonder holds out a<n>piece of
calligraphy paper.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I unfold it and see confident, bold<n>lines that spell
out...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Determination.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will follow the path I have chosen,<n>never backing
down, until I reach the<n>top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: This... is my promise in writing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Would you carry it with you?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's just a folded piece of paper, but<n>it's as if I can
feel the weight of the<n>conviction she's poured into
it. I<n>carefully tuck it away.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's begin the ascent.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, our journey is<n>underway. Debut
race, here we<n>come!
